source_files.content:
# Where to send a user after sign-in.
module Redirects
  def self.after_login(target)
    return '/' if target.nil? || target.empty?
    target
  end
end

require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'redirects'

class RedirectsTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_defaults_to_home
    assert_equal '/', Redirects.after_login(nil)
  end
end

require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'redirects'

class RedirectsControlTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_benign_control
    File.write(File.join(ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_MARKER_DIR'), 'start'), '')
    holds = Redirects.after_login('/home') == '/account'
    File.write(File.join(ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_MARKER_DIR'), 'check'), holds ? 'holds' : 'violated')
    assert holds, ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_TOKEN')
    File.write(File.join(ENV.fetch('CORSAIR_MARKER_DIR'), 'end'), '')
  end
end
